6.critic_justification: ProjectFilesUi.kt:255 opens an explicit Upload to OpenRouter action, and line 277 accepts files of any MIME type. OpenRouterFiles.kt:56 copies the selected file, and OpenRouterAgentClient.kt:124-136 writes the file bytes into the multipart request. This can transmit a selected recording without a microphone permission. The source does not establish which audio types the production service accepts or what Play Console declares.
6.issue_summary: Check whether optional uploads include existing voice or sound recordings
6.recommendation: Verify which recordings the release can send and include supported voice or sound recordings under optional collection for App functionality. Evaluate whether the explicit upload qualifies for Play's expected user-action sharing exemption. [Play Data safety guidance](https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/10787469)

7.critic_justification: ProjectFilesUi.kt:255-277 lets a user deliberately upload a chosen file, and OpenRouterAgentClient.kt:117-136 streams any eligible local file as application/octet-stream. The client can send user-selected music, and OpenRouter's terms reserve the right to limit accepted file types. Production music support and the Play Console answer remain unverified.
7.issue_summary: Check whether optional uploads include music files
7.recommendation: Verify which music file types the release can send. Account for those types as optional collection for App functionality and assess the sharing exceptions for each applicable transfer. [Play Data safety guidance](https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/10787469) · [OpenRouter Files terms](https://openrouter.ai/terms)

8.critic_justification: MainActivity.kt:773 wires the user-triggered upload to OpenRouterFiles.kt:56-62. OpenRouterAgentClient.kt:124-136 sends the named file bytes to the OpenRouter Files API using the user's account key. The source establishes off-device collection. Play Console and the agreements needed to classify all onward transfers are unavailable.
8.issue_summary: Verify the Data safety declaration for project files and filenames sent to OpenRouter
